'''Mare Tino (VSC) This Deal Is Getting Virtual''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

* '''GPN category:''' Standard

This Deal deck with mains and all six virtual cards.

== Strategy ==

REPLY TO COMMENT:

I now those are great cards for the deck, but what do you suggest I should drop? Offcourse with leaving the six [V] cards in it. BTW those OS ships cannot hold the sector by themselves when they're up against Falcons with four destinies and or smuggler beatdown.

Here is a deck with all six [V] cards for DS.

Get your interior sites, drop as much locations as you can (you need the force). Wait with B:CC if you want to setup Dark Deal and are not sure of your spacefleet.

Setup Dark Deal and/or Occupation and enjoy. Most of the time you go for Occupation and Dark Deal is an extra.

Cards that'll fit nice in:

- Force Field

- Crush The Rebellion

- Blast Door Controls

- Another Fighter Cover

- I Can't Shake Him!

- Weapon Levitation

- Mobilization Points

- Imperial Artillery

DARTH VADER

Great in space, but also good on the ground. If you really need him on the ground you can use SRF & WYB to get his TIE, then get Vader and then get his saber. Or use Blizzard 4 to get Vader with Saber for free.

PROPHETESS:

Great card, the better your opponent, the better this card gets. Use her every turn as your first action on opponent's Reserve Deck. No more tracking destinies! And she's a deploy 2 forfeit 5 character. Too bad she isn't an Imperial so she could use the Assault Rifle.

BLACK 2:

Cancels DARKLIGHTER SPIN combo.

ASSAULT RIFLE:

May fire at same or ADJACENT SITE.

When hit target is LOST.

Can be pulled by Mara and then works with Fighter Cover or she can pass it to another Imperial warrior.

FUSION GENERATOR SUPPLY TANKS:

Cancels POWER PIVOT (Executor) and HYPER ESCAPE.

BLASTER RACK:

Fetches your LIGHTSABERS.

Martijn Peeters
